WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id, created_at as user_created_at
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    fu.id as user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) as order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fu.id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) as order_rank
  FROM facebook_users fu
  JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = fu.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY fu.id, oi.order_id
),
first_two_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    order_rank
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_rank <= 2
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    f1.user_id,
    f1.order_date as first_order_date,
    f2.order_date as second_order_date,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (f2.order_date - f1.order_date)) as days_between
  FROM first_two_orders f1
  JOIN first_two_orders f2 ON f1.user_id = f2.user_id AND f1.order_rank = 1 AND f2.order_rank = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) as median_days
FROM order_pairs

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at)::date AS acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    THEN u.id 
  END) AS users_with_order,
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' 
    THEN u.id 
  END)::double precision / COUNT(DISTINCT u.id))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id 
  AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
  AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at)
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH user_orders AS (

  FROM public.users u

ranked_orders AS (

  FROM user_orders

order_pairs AS (

  FROM ranked_orders

)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM (third_order_time - second_order_time))::integer) AS median_days
FROM order_pairs

user_orders AS (

  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
user_order_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_created_at) AS order_rank
  FROM user_orders
),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN order_created_at END) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_created_at END) AS second_order_date
  FROM user_order_ranks
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_created_at END) IS NOT NULL
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date) AS days_to_second_order
  FROM first_second_orders
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_second_order) AS median_days
FROM days_between

WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    SUM(sale_price) AS order_value,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_created_at
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    AND status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
user_first_order AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(order_created_at) AS first_order_date
  FROM order_values
  GROUP BY user_id
),
classified_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    ov.user_id,
    ov.order_id,
    ov.order_value,
    CASE 
      WHEN ov.order_created_at = ufo.first_order_date THEN 'first'
      ELSE 'repeat'
    END AS order_type
  FROM order_values ov
  JOIN user_first_order ufo ON ufo.user_id = ov.user_id
)
SELECT 
  order_type,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_order_value
FROM classified_orders
GROUP BY order_type

    order_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_time,

  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
first_two_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    order_time,
    order_sequence
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_sequence <= 2
),
order_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_sequence = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_sequence = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
  FROM first_two_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

days_between AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    (second_order_time::date - first_order_time::date)::integer AS days_between_orders

)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between_orders) AS percentile_95

pivot AS (
